topic: Reselling: your teen turning $20 into $200 — and learning how business actually works
caption:
Your teen can turn $20 into $200 this weekend.

Thrift stores and garage sales are full of items people undervalue. Your teen learns to spot them, price them right, and sell them online.

That is supply and demand, profit margins, and negotiation learned by actually doing it.
